title: Connected etale origins with scalar-normalized geometric stalk arrows
statement: Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme, $g:Y\to X$ an immersion, $d$ an adic coefficient datum on $A$, and $M$ an adic tower [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-tower]. Suppose every level of $M$ is separately bounded and its inverse image along $g$, restricted along the specified finite coefficient comparison, has relatively finite lisse cohomology in every degree. Put $C=\widehat A$ and $J=IC$. There is an etale cover $\mathcal V$ of $Y$ with the following data on every member $V$: $V$ is connected, a point $v\in V$ is specified, and for each $n$ there is a bounded complex $L_n$ in $D(V_{et},C/J^{n+1})$ with finite locally constant cohomology. Every vanishing cohomology of $M_n$ gives vanishing cohomology of $L_n$. Let $K_n$ be the actual exact derived geometric stalk of $L_n$ at the algebraic closure point of $v$ [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks]. There are arrows $t_n:K_{n+1}\to\operatorname{Res} K_n$ universal for the consecutive quotient scalar restrictions. Relative finite lissity of the original restricted cohomology holds on every pro-etale refinement of $V$. For each $n$ and etale $Z\to V$, a supplied isomorphism $L_n|_Z\simeq\underline{K_n}$ transports to an isomorphism from constantAdicQuotientRealization of $K_n$ to the actual inverse image of $M_n$ on every pro-etale $W\to Z\to Y$ [lem-weil-pbc-constant-adic-quotient-scalar-comparison]. This theorem asserts no existence of an isomorphism trivializing $L_n$ and no covering sieve of markings.

proof.text: Cover Y by pointed connected open neighborhoods, taking a connected component of an affine neighborhood at each point. Components are open because the affine neighborhood is Noetherian. The point-indexed Cover.mkOfCovers also treats empty Y.

For each chart and each n apply the single finite quotient etale origin theorem to M.level n. Its vanishing property transfers the given n-dependent cohomological interval to the descended level. Retain finite local constancy, vanishing, refinement lissity, and conditional transport for arbitrary algebraic models.

For each pair n+1,n, finite-ring derived local constancy on the connected chart supplies two etale covers with constant models equal to the actual geometric stalks at its chosen point. Completion quotient finiteness follows from the bijective canonical quotient map and d.quotientFinite. Intersect the covers and select a member over the point. Restrict both constant models along the two pullback projections and use each origin transport to identify them with the two actual pulled-back levels. Apply constantAdicQuotient_model_reduction on this nonempty etale member to obtain the universal stalk arrow. Only a single consecutive pair is considered at a time.

Choose a universal arrow for each consecutive pair. Assemble the original presentation structure from the chosen point, descended levels, their derived bounds and other fields, and these arrows. Specialize arbitrary-model transport to the actual stalk at each n. All the assembly is proved Lean; no new marking sieve or simultaneous trivialization is needed.

lean.statement:
theorem lisse_tower_connected_etale_presentation
    (X Y : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X] (g : Y ⟶ X) [IsImmersion g]
    {A : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A) (M : AdicTower X d)
    (hbounded : ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ a b : ℤ, ∀ q : ℤ, (q < a ∨ b < q) →
      IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj (M.level n)))
    (hlisse : ∀ (n : ℕ) (q : ℤ),
      IsRelativelyFiniteLisseModule g (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1))
        ((pbcRestrict ((adicTowerInverseImage g).map
          (pbcLevelConstantComparison X d n).hom)).obj
            ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj
              ((adicTowerPullback g ((pbcAdicRings X d).obj (op n))).obj (M.level n))))) :
    ∃ 𝒱 : Cover.{u} etalePrecoverage Y, ∀ i : 𝒱.I₀,
      Nonempty (LisseTowerConnectedEtalePresentation X Y g d M
        (𝒱.etalePrecoverageToEtale i))
